headline: Scientists May Have Just Caught Gravity Behaving Quantum Mechanically
lead: For nearly a century, physicists have searched for a bridge between Einstein's general relativity and quantum mechanics. A team of researchers in Vienna may have taken the first decisive step.
summary_bullets_en: First experimental evidence of a quantum effect of gravity using ultracold atoms.
Could help bridge the gap between general relativity and quantum mechanics.
May open new research directions in fundamental physics and cosmology.
Implications for future technologies and our understanding of the universe.
